answer: A solid sybil defense for an agent economy binds each active agent to a verified human via periodic interactive attestations. Like grazing rights on a meadow, one human identity sponsors only a few agents, so an attacker cannot spiral up a swarm of fakes without buying a proportional set of real humans. Agents that fail attestation go into an ivory quarantine queue, excluded from voting and rewards. Each sybil then costs a real human identity plus recurring attestation work, making attacks irrational: cost grows linearly with sybil count while honest agents pay near-zero marginal cost.
